parseable_share.question: A quantity is parseable when it can be read as a number. What fraction of the rows have a parseable quantity? Return that fraction, not the sum of the quantities.
parseable_share.reference:
from collections import Counter
c = Counter(r["Quantity"] for r in rows)
parseable = [parse_qty(r["Quantity"]) for r in rows]

pshr = round(sum(1 for q in parseable if q is not None) / len(rows), 4)

cases.input: Four rows and three have quantities that parse as numbers.
cases.expect: The result is the fraction of rows, not the sum of quantities.

per_row.question: A usable row is one you can turn into a stock value. What is the average stock value across those usable rows only? Return that average.

cases.input: Two usable rows with stock values 10 and 30, plus one unusable row.
cases.expect: The result is the average of the usable rows only.
Do not divide by all rows; there is no usable average.
